acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the skills on disk and registry/skills.json, When nit skills runs, Then it lists every skill grouped by layer — base step, language, custom, global — and names the modules each is associated with.

Given a skill declared in a registry or module but absent from disk, When nit skills runs, Then it is listed as missing rather than omitted, since a silently dropped skill is what routing does at runtime.
Given no arguments, When nit skills runs, Then it exits 0 and its output reflects the repository's actual skills rather than a hardcoded list.
